integrity: The proof is analytical. Exact-rational checker output verifies 1,625 finite assertions, including a rigorous optimizer-root enclosure; these finite tests do not replace the infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: The results concern centered symmetric infinitely divisible laws with bounded Lévy support and actual finite positive variance. They do not establish optimal tail-probability constants, non-symmetric envelopes, or unbounded-jump analogues. A closely related 2026 directional-scale paper was available only through its abstract; priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp variance-exact sub-gamma envelopes for symmetric bounded Lévy jumps
